hero.definition: Aries is the AI-native front door for building on Alkanes and utilizing SUBFROST as a developer.

loop.title: One loop: knowledge, chain data, scaffolds
loop.lead: Aries is a free hosted MCP server. Point your coding agent at it and it gains three things:
loop.knowledgeBody: Alkanes and SUBFROST documentation, patterns, and hard-won gotchas, served directly inside your coding agent — so it stops guessing and starts answering from the ecosystem's working knowledge.
loop.chainDataBody: Live reads against real Alkanes state: tokens, pools, contract metadata, simulations. Your agent checks what is actually on-chain instead of hallucinating it.
loop.scaffoldsBody: Working starting points for contracts and integrations, generated from patterns that are known to build.
loop.flywheelBody: Every builder who hits a wall and writes down the fix makes Aries sharper for the next one. Corrections land in a shared incident corpus, and the next query reads them back. Aries gets smarter with every builder who uses it.
loop.readOnlyTitle: Read-only by design, free for every developer
loop.readOnlyBody: Aries never signs, never broadcasts, and never touches wallets or keys. It emits docs, live chain reads, and scaffolds for you to run locally — and it is free for every developer building on Alkanes.

access.title: Join the group, then claim your key
access.body: Beta keys are issued to members of the builders group. Join first, and the Aries Keymaster bot hands you a key in a direct message.
access.step1: Join the builders group on Telegram.
access.step2: Open a direct message with the Aries Keymaster bot, @AriesKeyBot, and press Start.
access.step3: Your key arrives in that same chat. Your Telegram account needs a username set.
access.note: The builders group is where questions get answered and incidents get filed.

registry.title: Register as an Alkanes builder
registry.lead: One registration, one public identity for the work you ship on Alkanes. Connect your X account, connect a Bitcoin wallet, and sign once to bind the two.

x.title: Connect your X account
x.body: Your numeric X user ID is what the record is keyed on. Your handle is stored as a snapshot for display, so renaming it later does not break anything.

wallet.title: Connect a Bitcoin wallet
wallet.body: The wallet proves the record is yours. Nothing is spent and no transaction is built — the wallet is only asked to sign a message.
wallet.subfrost: The recommended builder wallet. Signs BIP-322 messages and works with Alkanes and SUBFROST directly.
wallet.unisat: The alternative. Also signs BIP-322 messages.
wallet.resumeNote: Installing a wallet extension reloads the page. Your progress is saved in this browser, so you can come straight back here.

sign.title: Sign the record
sign.body: One signature binds this wallet to your X account. The message names the action, so it can never be reused for anything else.

done.title: You are registered
done.body: Your builder record is live. You can rotate the wallet later from this page; rotations are shown on the record.
